programs.description: A devout Muslim Indian man is tasked with repairing a lorry in order to transport the ashes of Mahatma Gandhi. However, when communal violence strikes, he is left with a troubling dilemma.
Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna.
NRI Shyam comes to India to fulfil the final wish of his late mother who wanted him to marry an Indian girl. Unbeknownst to him, the girl he falls in love with is a pawn in the hands of his enemies.
Kailash's uncle discovers a formula to save energy, which could make him very wealthy. Mr Mehta, an industrialist, envies his success and devises an evil plan to steal the formula.

After returning to his village, Ravi learns that the local farmers are being oppressed by a despotic landlord. Soon, he decides to contest the panchayat elections against the tyrant and put an end to his cruel rule.
Raj is hired as a bodyguard for Komal, and the two grow closer to each other over time. However, things get complicated when he comes across Nihal, the man who molested his sister.
When Amba Prasad realises the harsh truth that his relatives just care for his money, he leaves home. Upon reaching a village, he meets Arun and Aarti and his life changes forever.
After the murder of millionaire Ranjit Rai, his mistress Radha is apprehended by the police. Journalist Rakesh teams up with his friends and a skilled defence lawyer to uncover the truth.
Vipul and Saurabh, two friends, decide to put an end to the misery of couples by starting a love hotel. However, the local political group is not in favour of their venture.
Suraj, a police officer, is assigned to arrest his friend Yash, whose father runs an illegal business. He must now persuade his friend to make his father change his ways to avoid the consequences.
Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

An aspiring screenwriter becomes involved in a diamond heist while writing a script for his film and struggles to evade the police.
Sam Bharucha, a police inspector, often comes across youth gangs creating nuisance in the city. When a young mobster is killed by him during a shootout, he embarks on a mission to find his family.
Frustrated with his wife, Namdev, a businessman, decides to end his life. However, things take a turn when he envisions his dead father who encourages him to rethink his decision.
Dushant, an aspiring singer, is encouraged by Jaya to achieve his dreams. However, after Dushant becomes successful, his other friends try to create misunderstandings between him and Jaya.
A woman is held captive by a group of kidnappers to compel her MI5 husband to exterminate the prime minister of the country.
Returning from a foreign land, Pawan, a cold-hearted man, sets out to take his late brother's son back home. However, a string of events forces him to rethink his rigid principles.
JD, an ambitious journalist known for integrity, spirals into addiction and scandal. Subsequently, his career and reputation crumble when he's accused of raping a colleague who works for him.
A 42-year-old writer falls in love with a 22-year-old beauty queen. However, things get complicated when his roommate encourages him to make up stories to impress her.
Three men try different methods to woo their neighbour. However, her father wants her to get married to someone from his community.
A group of passengers whose flight is delayed due to a technical error are left to wait indefinitely. In that time, they get the chance to interact with each other and sort out their issues.

Amit, the son of a taxi driver, and Reema, a rich businessman's daughter, fall in love. However, Reema's father wants to marry her to Vicky, whose father is the biggest gangster in Mumbai. How will their love triumph?
Jay, an expert in gambling, works for a criminal unaware that he is being used to gain military secrets. When the police discover this, they assign Inspector Vijay, Jay's lookalike, to stop him.

programs.showName: Alag: He Is Different ... He Is Alone ...
programs.description: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programs.showName: Rafoo Chakkar: Fun on the Run
programs.description: Two brothers, Manjeet and Parmeet, run away from their home in order to avoid getting married. Eventually, they lead a life of crime and things take a turn when they get arrested.
Raja, a good-for-nothing fortune hunter, sets his sights on the daughter of a wealthy businessman. Before long, love takes over and brings about a twist in the tale.
Dinanath, a devout Hindu, wishes to get his son Shankar married to Salma, an orphan who lives with them. However, Shankar's childhood sweetheart Neetu returns to his life.
A doctor puts out a job posting to recruit a nurse for his clinics in rural India. Unaware of a candidate's dark past, he hires her and eventually falls in love with her.

India 1974; Family/Romance; Dir. Basu Bhattacharya; Cast: Rajesh Khanna, Sharmila Tagore, Dennis Clement. Amar and Mansi's marital life becomes strained when his job in an advertising agency places him in close proximity to beautiful models.

programs.showName: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programs.description: Haunted by the past, Vijay turns to crime, while Ravi, his younger brother, becomes an honest police officer. Fate pits them against each other when Ravi is sent to nab Vijay.
Satpal Chauhan, a social worker from Haryana, works for women empowerment and also strives to create an alcohol-free society. However, while pursuing his goals, he faces several hardships.

A lawyer goes into hiding after being falsely accused of committing a crime, while his wife gives birth to twins. Years later, fate reunites the family under difficult circumstances.
A decorated school teacher's life is upended by devastating rumours, which ultimately lead to his death. His son Kundan now seeks vengeance.
Najma is in love with Akhtar but cannot marry him until he is financially stable. An elderly Shakir promises to help Akhtar set up his business in exchange for Najma finding a suitable bride for him.
A father pretends to be a rich industrialist to improve his son's chances of marrying in to wealth. However, his plan backfires on him when his true identity is found out.
Two individuals fall in love and marry against their parents' wishes. However, their life takes a dramatic turn when the woman is diagnosed with a life-threatening disease.
A young woman, conning people to run an orphanage, falls in love with a rich man under the disguise of a princess. However, their romance crumbles when her truth comes out.
A widowed woman's daughter elopes with her lover. Years later, when her granddaughter also falls in love, she strives to accept the relationship.
Raja, a taxi driver, falls in love with Aarti, a rich girl and marries her against her parents' wishes. Later, her stepmother tries to create differences between the couple.
After his boss, Jai Singh, commits suicide, Subhash, a chauffeur, conspires to get his insurance money. He then teams up with Jai's wife, Mallika, to make the suicide look like a well-planned murder.

A young Sudhir is adopted by Mr Chaturvedi and develops a strong bond with his son, Prashant. Later, when the police arrest Prashant for performing illegal abortions, Sudhir comes to his rescue.
Jai's father asks him to meet Sunita before getting married to her. However, complications arise when Jai falls in love with Kimi, while on his way to Sunita's village.
Kumar and Rohit, who are childhood friends, soon turn enemies when Kumar molests Rohit's fiancée out of jealousy. She feels unworthy of Rohit and calls off the wedding.
Gita, a girl from a wealthy family, falls in love with an idealistic Avinash who has stern principles in life. However, his changed behaviour post marriage troubles her.
Badshah Khan travels to India to behead the man who killed Benazir's father and win her hand in marriage. He succeeds in his mission but is caught by Ranveer Singh, a jailer.

Police Inspector Kapil Khanna realises that his baby boy has been switched with a girl child by the hospital and files a lawsuit against the owner, Robert Decosta, while trying to find his missing son.
Urvashi who becomes an actress with the help of Keshav, ends up marrying him. However, things complicate when she indulges in affairs with prominent men in the film industry.
In the aftermath of Gujarat's violent 2002 riots, victims find their lives changed forever and reel from the deep impact the upheaval left on them.
A policeman sacrifices his life protecting Savitri and her twins from a gangster. Savitri raises the fallen officer's son as her twins, now separated, grow into a lawyer and a sniper.
Jeet, a former judo champion, decides to travel to Canada in search of employment. However, since she has no money, she seeks the help of a local man who ends up cheating her.

Avatar leads a happy life with his wife, Radha, and his sons, Chander and Ramesh. However, consumed by their greed and ambitions, Avatar's sons betray him, but he soon reaches new heights of success.
Rajesh, the superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend, Shekar, in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler, who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.
D K Malhotra leads a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. But all of this changes when he is forced to bring a boy, who is his son from a previous relationship, home after his mother dies.
When Prakash's father dies, he is forced to shoulder the financial responsibilities of his large family. However, his troubles increase when his younger brother leaves him home to join a gang.
A woman gets stuck in India when her flight to a foreign country gets delayed. While travelling in India, she meets Tony, a tour guide, and things take a turn when he falls in love with her.
Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna.
Falsely accused of murder, Raja becomes a target for Vijay, a police inspector and his lover's brother. In a bid to end his misery and catch the real culprit, Raja sets out on a mission.

Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.
After his stepfather is murdered, Sahil gets arrested, but he manages to escape prison to prove his innocence. However, Inspector Udham Singh sets off to capture him.
While filming a documentary in a prison, Chandrika comes across three unique stories and, somewhere in between, finds what her heart has been seeking.

When Anita commits suicide, Neeraj suspects foul play and decides to investigate the truth. However, things take a turn when he starts seeing Anita everywhere.
Talented sisters, Sita and Lata, are renowned performing artists. However, the rivalry between them leads to a competition with far-reaching consequences.

Childhood friends Ram and Avtar face a love triangle when Ram falls for Sangeeta, whom Avtar also loves. Ram sacrifices his love for Avtar, but their enemy Gundappaswami threatens to expose the truth.
Salman and Rukhsar's love brings two warring families face to face, only for tradition, dowry demands and heartbreak to test their fragile bond.
When an expelled police inspector, an outlaw and a commissioner's son are implicated by a dealer, they unite to seek revenge and prove they are not culprits.
Four unemployed youth make a plan to kidnap a gangster, Irfan Khan, in an attempt to win the ransom money. However, the powerful don has other plans.
With the Interpol on their trail, a group of international smugglers lose the shipments with all their treasures in a cyclone. A team is sent to salvage the sunken ship and scuttle the gang's plan.

Scolded by his family for being a miser, wealthy industrialist Dhaniram loves money. However, his two sons, Ajay and Vijay, are manipulated by their wives and despise their father, looking for ways to entrap him. Soon, he gets into a clash with a tax officer and the officer's siblings devise an evil plot to plunder the businessman's fortune.
Karan, a gangster, falls in love with Kajal, but she marries Raju because of her father's poor health. Later, when Raju finds out about his father's illegal business, Karan is hired to kill him.
Rajveer, a police officer, is tasked with protecting a nine-year-old heir, Abbas. However, the job gets complicated when Nazir, a dangerous criminal, seeks to harm the child.

A policeman and a reformed criminal go to Kenya to comprehend a syndicate leader. However, they must break the rules of the land defended by Surya Pratap, a Kenyan police inspector.
A rich girl runs away from home and settles down with a truck driver. However, her dream life is shattered when she learns that her new lover has been accused of murder.
Navendu looks after his stepmother and half-brothers to fulfil the promise he has made to his father. However, their family falls apart after one of them marries a rich, controlling woman.
Sagar sets out to exact revenge against Dr Narendra, a smuggler who killed his father. But Sagar is soon framed for the murder of a woman and sent to jail.
Yash, Taj and Gaurav fall madly in love with Isha, a beautiful and charming woman. However, Isha is friendly with all three men, unaware of their feelings towards her.
After losing his job owing to his arrogance and subsequently his son, Vijay, Atmaram realises his mistake and decides to turn over a new leaf.
After his wife Rukmini is abducted by his cruel brother, Vishwam is forced to confront the deep-rooted issues of power and control that plague their village, leading to tragic consequences.
